Dil Bechara Review: You Couldn't Have Asked for Better

5 out of 55/5
Posted By : Jithin J Prasad | Date : 24-07-2020

Well, Watching this film's really hard for me considering the fact that Sushant Singh Rajput is no more. But I watched it in one piece so that I can write a pure review for the movie.

I don't know guys, I thought of writing a lot of things here but, something is not letting me write it, perhaps yeah like most of us even I miss him too. Such a great talent and a great human being, can't still hold on to the fact that he's no more.

I give this film a rating of 5/5, yes the only film to which I have ever given a full rating. The reason, well some people may say that it's sympathy, but I don't know maybe or may not be, but I just did, and it's not just Sushant who was awesome in the film but the whole cast and crew. Mukesh Chhabra's direction, the casting of Sushant Singh Rajput,Sanjana Sanghi,Milind Gunaji,Javed Jaffrey,Swastika Mukherjee and the cameo of Saif Ali Khan was also perfect, when you add the background score of A.R.Rahman to it the whole thing became complete.

I am writing the review in tears, well not much of a review but yeah whatever this is. and I really hope Rajini sir see this film and shares his response because the character of Sushant happens to be a die-hard Thalaivar fan just like I am.

Sushant, it's a good journey, all though you died too soon you will live in our hearts forever, like that saying good people die soon just like Swami Vivekananda, James Dean among others, yeah they died soon but the whole world is still getting inspired by them just like you are going to be. Rest in Peace brother.

and to all the guys who are reading this, please don't pirate this film from torrent or telegram because it's free for everyone, yeah Disney+Hotstar might get a little benefit from making it free but hey..! they did deliver it for both subscribers and nonsubscribers. So watch it for One Last Time.
